description: Create a new Space in a Workspace. Optionally enable multiple assignees and toggle features. Returns the created Space with its id. Use to start a new top-level area of work.

features.description: Feature toggles object, e.g. { due_dates: { enabled: true }, time_tracking: { enabled: true } }. Omit to keep defaults.

multiple_assignees.description: If true, tasks in this Space can have more than one assignee.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_space
